error_list.description: Required DTM*063 (Ship-By Date) is absent at the shipment HL level.
error_list.recommended_fix: Insert DTM*063*YYYYMMDD immediately after DTM*011 within the HL*1 (Shipment) loop. Example: DTM*063*20260902
error_list.chargeback_risk: RetailerA chargeback code CB-0042: Missing Ship-By Date — $250–$500 per ASN

error_list.description: REF qualifier 'ZZ' is non-standard. RetailerA expects 'BM' (Bill of Lading) for shipment-level REF segments.
error_list.recommended_fix: Change REF*ZZ to REF*BM and supply a valid bill of lading number.
error_list.chargeback_risk: Low — may cause ASN rejection on some RetailerA distribution center systems

primary.hypothesis: DTM*063 was omitted because sender's ERP does not map a Ship-By Date field for this order type
primary.evidence: Same pattern observed in 3 prior ASNs from ACMESUPPLIER to RETAILERA in last 60 days

alternatives.hypothesis: DTM*011 was intended to serve as the ship date and DTM*063 was assumed redundant
Segment omitted due to EDI mapping software version mismatch
